title: Municipal Infrastructure & Exposure Mapping: Orange County Coastal Zone

correlations.exposure_finding: Unredacted Tract 405 acquisition records and Phase I ESA PDFs (17642 Beach Blvd) successfully harvested due to directory exposure.
NBPD runs bare IIS 10.0 with NO WAF; ASP.NET_SessionId cookies exposed. Vulnerability mirrors Huntington Beach unredacted CMS exposure.
Direct IIS 10.0 exposure; NO WAF layer. Matches South County municipal hosting vulnerability cluster.

strategic_insight: The South County coastal corridor exhibits a systematic failure to deploy Web Application Firewalls (WAF) across critical law enforcement and municipal data repositories, relying on raw Microsoft-IIS 10.0 and vulnerable CMS platforms (Revize). This structural weakness directly enabled the extraction of the Huntington Beach Tract 405 (HBNC) environmental concealment records.
